end.parentNote: Ananya practised making estimates, grouping objects in 10s, and deciding whether an estimate was close to the actual number. They correctly judged that 40 is close to 38 and used repeated addition to find 30, but sometimes counted groups as single objects; this mix-up was still present at the end. At home, use small piles of buttons or beans and ask, “How many groups of 10? How many objects altogether?”
